description: holon-coherence/src/ contains 4 silent except Exception: pass blocks and lacks a CI AST ratchet capping broad except Exception catches per module.
goal: Eliminate all silent except Exception: pass blocks in src/holon_coherence/commands/ca.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py, and src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py by replacing them with narrowed exception types (such as OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) and explicit debug or warning logging, and add a fast AST-based ratchet test in tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py that caps except Exception counts per module so unratcheted broad catches fail CI while equal or lower counts pass cleanly. Update unit tests in tests/commands/test_ca.py, tests/commands/test_docker_ops.py, tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py, and tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Narrowing silent except Exception: pass handlers prevents subtle CLI/proxy failures from disappearing while an AST ratchet stops new broad catches from creeping back in.
acceptance_criteria: Zero silent except Exception: pass blocks remain in holon-coherence/src/ (specifically across src/holon_coherence/commands/ca.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py, and src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py).
CI fails if unratcheted except Exception catches are added outside explicit proxy/CLI boundary handlers.

tests/commands/test_ca.py, tests/commands/test_docker_ops.py, tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py, and tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py pass uv run pytest and uv run task lint with zero docstrings or comments and unchanged holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
